description: Start watching a website, API, server or certificate. Only the target is required; sensible defaults cover the rest, and the first check runs immediately. Use check_type keyword with keyword to require text on the page, ssl_cert or dns with a bare hostname, ping with a hostname or IP, and tcp with host:port. For a cron job, backup or script, use check_type heartbeat: no target is needed, interval_seconds is how often the job runs, and the answer has the URL the job must call each time it finishes. A beat that is later than the interval plus grace_period_seconds opens an incident.

alert_channel_ids.description: Alert these channels (ids from list_alert_channels) when it goes down. Without this, nobody is alerted.

expected_status_codes.description: HTTP codes that count as up (default [200]).

grace_period_seconds.description: For heartbeat: how late a beat may be before it counts as missed. The API default applies when left out.

interval_seconds.description: How often to check. The plan sets the minimum (Free 300, Pro 30, Agency 15). Defaults to the plan's default. For heartbeat: how often the job runs.

keyword.description: For keyword checks: text that must appear in the response.

keyword_absent.description: For keyword checks: alert when the keyword IS present instead.

name.description: A display name. Defaults to the target.

organization.description: Organization id. Leave out to use your own account; resellers can name a client organization.

regions.description: Region codes from list_regions. Leave out for the default set. Not for heartbeat, which is called rather than checked.

target.description: What to watch: a URL (https://example.com/health), a hostname, or host:port for TCP. Required except for heartbeat.
